original_brief: Show a reusable fabric shopping bag upright with two handles and a few purchased items peeking above the opening. Make the flexible sides and carrying handles clearly distinct from a rigid shopping basket. Reject a backpack, paper-only carrier definition, wheeled trolley, or decorative gift bag that obscures the intended shopping use.
accepted_brief: Show a plain open retail shopping bag upright in a three-quarter view, with a tall solid-sided body, two separate loop handles and a visible opening. Preserve the inspected 3dicons dynamic color source. Keep the tall solid body and paired loops visually distinct from the accepted squat slotted shopping basket. Exclude wheels, backpack straps, a closed top, a bow, a gift tag, tissue paper and gift-specific decoration. The illustration does not narrow the definition to a particular material or require visible contents.
